chapter: Absinthe House, Kid Rene and Lee Collins
title: Playing with Kid Rene's band and trombone subs
summary: He describes Kid Rene's band members, Morris French as regular trombonist, and subbing for or hiring substitutes.

story.theme_name: Who was in the band: naming sidemen and personnel
story.community_name: Who played in the band: reciting personnel

blocks.x: Well, what about Kid Rene? You worked with him some, I think you're talking about. Oh yeah, I worked with Rene.

A whole lot of different jobs, yeah. Well, I worked with putting all the musicians in the city, especially if your musicians come up in my time, you know. Like Willie Paggio, Kid Rene, all them parts like that, Punch and all of them.
Well, what about Rene? What band did he in? Where did he work? Well, Rene worked all different places, you know.
He didn't have no study place to work, you know. He worked all different spots jobs. Jobs here, jobs in the country, different things. You know, places.
Huh? Who was in Rene's band?

Oh, Rene, Rene, Rene, his brother Joe Rene, you know. Morris French. Morris French. Morris French. Morris French. Simon, Simon Moriam was playing the bass at the time that I remember. Son, Son was playing banjo. Son, yes. Son, uh, Son, I thought I knew Son playing banjo. Son, playing banjo. Son, uh, and Zeb was playing, Zeb was playing clannet.
Who did you say was, you were playing the trombone with it pretty regular?
You were with it pretty regular?
No, no, I just played like, like this trombone player couldn't, couldn't play like I had to go play, you know. Who was his regular trombone?

I see. Morris French. It's like, if I can't play tonight I'll come, I hire Winner or some of them boys will go play my plays, I'd say, because I can't play, you know. They go play, Homer, his brother Clemence, some of them boys like that, well they go play. They do for me, if they can't play, they call me, I'll go play in their plays.
